zh.title: 同样是 0.5，为什么信任状态不能只存一个分数
zh.summary: 固定源码实验中，两种同为 0.5 的信任状态在相同反馈后更新不同。恢复估计器、展示分数和指导决策，需要分别保存和检验。

en.title: The same 0.5 is not the same recoverable trust state
en.summary: A pinned source probe finds equal trust means that update differently under identical feedback. Estimator recovery, displayed information and decision guidance require separate treatment.
